answer: Make every identity post an escalating cluster bond: a first identity locks 150 units, but any second identity funded from the same wallet, device fingerprint, or payout route locks 300, the third 600, doubling each time, and the whole cluster is slashed together if one member cheats. A farm cannot split one stake across many faces: each extra face costs twice the last, and shared funding links them into one forfeitable pool. Like a crystal in a meadow, one onyx stone is cheap, but a field of identical stones betrays a single grower who pays for the whole field.
